translatorNotes: PRICING POST: figures kept exact. Every dollar figure carried over unchanged and rendered with the currency named as US-Dollar. German thousands separator applied: 1.000 / 1.500 / 8.000 / 25.000 etc. Percentages kept (20 bis 30 Prozent). Timeframes kept (3 bis 6 Monate).

Key glossary conversions verified: '$3.70 for every $1' -> '3,70 US-Dollar für jeden investierten Dollar'; cost -> Kosten; build cost -> Umsetzungskosten (table header 'Build' -> 'Umsetzung'); monthly fees -> monatliche Gebühren (table header 'Monthly' -> 'Monatlich'); payback -> Amortisation; tier -> Stufe (table header 'Tier' -> 'Stufe'). '$8,000 to $25,000+' kept the plus sign as '25.000+ US-Dollar'.
All pricing-table labels translated; all numeric values kept exact. Table captions translated.
Brand/tool names kept literal: Zapier, Make, n8n. Cited sources kept literal: AutomationForce, SoluLab. wordCount 2800 kept in JSON-LD. mentions array of SoftwareApplication kept.
'client intake' in the project table rendered as 'Mandatsannahme' per the law-firm glossary; 'WISMO' kept as the acronym.
No em-dashes used anywhere; commas and rewrites replace the English dashes and the ' — ' in the CTA heading.
Internal same-site links repointed to /de (services, industries, blog, contact). /privacy, /terms, sitemap, mailto, tel and external URLs (Unsplash, LinkedIn) left unchanged.
Language switcher rebuilt as three-way with EN + ES links and DE current.
No lead/audit form on this page, so no window.__i18n form block was added.
'You own everything we build' rendered as the fixed glossary phrase 'Dir gehört alles, was wir bauen.'
